summary_for_children: Al-Mu'minun begins by describing successful believers: humble in prayer, avoiding idle talk, giving charity and keeping promises. It reminds us how Allah created us and sends rain in just measure.
environment_concept: Terraces of the successful believers: a quiet stepped terrace (23:2-3), rain held in great basins (23:18), palms and vines (23:19), a great olive tree (23:20) and an empty shipyard (23:27).
architecture_and_scenery: Terraced garden with palm and vine rows, a single great olive tree on a slope, a reservoir, and a ship-building yard at its lower edge.

palette.atmosphere: Calm, the sound of water held in reservoirs

areas.name: Terrace of Turning from Idle Talk
areas.description: A path where noisy chatter fades as the player walks on.

areas.name: Measured Rain Reservoir
areas.description: Rain gathered and held in the earth.

areas.name: Olive Tree of Sinai
areas.description: A great olive tree on a slope.

activities.name: Qualities ladder
activities.description: Light each terrace by matching it to its ayah.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Fill the reservoir
activities.description: Carry four jars of rain water to the basins.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration links each terrace to a quality and asks the child about their own day.
learning_objectives: List the qualities of believers in 23:1-11

ayah_environment_connections.element: Terrace of Turning from Idle Talk

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (ark, bowls, olives, palms, steps, stones, vine) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
